rows.operation: National Risk Register 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: The register provides national likelihood and impact assessments for resilience planning; it must not be converted into a deterministic local, household or exact-parcel hazard score.

rows.operation: Ambulance Quality Indicators Systems Indicators for June 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Ambulance-service incident and response-time measures are service-area and monthly operational statistics; they do not establish emergency response performance at a specific address or parcel.

rows.operation: A&E attendances and emergency admissions June 2026 and Q1 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Provider-level attendances, admissions and waiting-time aggregates describe health-system activity and cannot be attributed to an exact household, building or parcel.

rows.operation: Building Safety Regulator approval application data April to June 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Application volumes, determination times and outcomes concern regulatory workflow for higher-risk buildings; they do not prove the compliance or safety condition of a named building or parcel.

rows.operation: Food hygiene ratings downloadable open data exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Ratings reflect conditions found at the recorded inspection or visit date; they are business-establishment observations and must not be generalized to neighbouring parcels or current conditions without freshness checks.

rows.operation: Food Hygiene Rating Scheme API version 2 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: API coordinates and ratings describe registered food businesses and inspection results; location data do not establish wider environmental or parcel safety.

rows.operation: UK Government Emergency Alerts current status exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: The current-alert state is a time-sensitive national service snapshot; absence of an alert is not proof that a locality or parcel has no hazard.
